// PR-5R2 WO8 - image V: device verification of the PR-5R2 timing work. Test firmware, not
// product code. The frame sequence is the runtime's own ui_handler(); nothing re-implements it.
//
// Screen (ui/screens/screen_measure.xml, generated by this worktree's CLI 0.13.0):
//   ticker  scroll_circular label, 40 px/s, initial delay 1000 ms  (obj index 0)
//   clock   HH:MM:SS clock, blink on, bound to a time subject      (obj index 1)
//   caption static label                                           (obj index 2)
//
// The clock's time subject is kept current by a u8g2gl_wall_clock. NO application code writes
// seconds. The host time function reports "unknown" for the first 5 s after boot (the panel
// shows --:--:--), then kBaseEpoch + esp_timer time, with the milliseconds into the second.
// The loop is d = ui_handler(display); delay(d), with d capped at 1000 ms as a safety net
// only; the number of cap hits is reported (should be 0 while the ticker scrolls).
//
// Phases (after a boot pump that lets the clock settle):
//   D1  30 s, blink on,  loop = delay(min(d, 1000))
//   D2  20 s, blink off, same loop
//   U   10 s, uncapped ui_handler() loop (no delay)
//
// Definitions (printed again in the "method" line):
//   sent        a ui_handler() call that took > kSendThresholdUs (a full sendBuffer() is ms on
//               this bus; a call without one is tens of us; min/max are printed to prove it)
//   changed     the 2048-byte buffer differs from the copy taken after the previous call
//   redundant   sent && !changed
//   idle wake   neither sent nor changed
//   second latency  esp_timer at the END of the ui_handler() call in which the clock subject
//               took a new second, minus that second's boundary (kBaseEpoch-relative second k
//               begins at esp_timer = k_since_boot * 1e6 us). Includes the frame time.
//   scroll rate (steps-1)/(t_last_step - t_first_step) from the label's scroll_x_ read after
//               every call. LIMITATION: this reads the offset via `#define private public`
//               and sees only what is committed by the END of each call; a call that jumps
//               more than 1 px is counted as that many steps and flagged under jumps_gt1px.
//               It is a measurement of the label's logical offset, not of the pixels the
//               panel shows (that is the owner's eye on the ticker).
//
// Serial 115200 (USB CDC on boot), tag "U8G2GL-V ", key=value. After the run the summary is
// reprinted every 5 s and ends "U8G2GL-V end".

#include "ui.hpp"  // Generated; first, so its capacities precede u8g2gl_config.h

#include <Arduino.h>
#include <SPI.h>
#include <U8g2lib.h>
#include <esp_timer.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "u8g2gl/u8g2gl_clock.h"
#include "u8g2gl/u8g2gl_core.h"
#include "u8g2gl/u8g2gl_helpers.h"
#include "u8g2gl/u8g2gl_version.h"
#include "u8g2gl/u8g2gl_wall_clock.h"

#define private public
#include "u8g2gl/u8g2gl_label.h"
#undef private

static constexpr int kPinCs = 10;
static constexpr int kPinDc = 9;
static constexpr int kPinSck = 48;
static constexpr int kPinMiso = 47;
static constexpr int kPinMosi = 38;

static U8G2_SSD1322_NHD_256X64_F_4W_HW_SPI display(U8G2_R0, kPinCs, kPinDc, U8X8_PIN_NONE);

static constexpr uint32_t kPhaseD1Ms = 30000;
static constexpr uint32_t kPhaseD2Ms = 20000;
static constexpr uint32_t kPhaseUMs = 10000;
static constexpr uint32_t kSendThresholdUs = 2000;
static constexpr uint32_t kDeadlineCapMs = 1000;
static constexpr int64_t kUnknownForUs = 5000000;  // time unknown for the first 5 s after boot
static constexpr uint32_t kBaseEpoch = 12u * 3600u + 34u * 60u + 56u;
static constexpr uint32_t kBootPumpUntilMs = 6500;  // let the first known second land
static constexpr size_t kBufBytes = 2048;
static constexpr int kMaxLat = 64;
static constexpr int kMaxRedundantLog = 16;

static u8g2gl_label* s_ticker = nullptr;
static u8g2gl_clock* s_clock = nullptr;
static u8g2gl_wall_clock s_wall_clock;  // static: must not move while in use

static uint8_t s_prev[kBufBytes];
static const char* s_runtime_str = "";

static uint32_t tickNow() { return static_cast<uint32_t>(millis()); }

// The host's time function: unknown for 5 s after boot, then base epoch + esp_timer time.
static bool timeFn(uint32_t* epoch_seconds, uint16_t* millis_into_second) {
    const int64_t us = esp_timer_get_time();
    if (us < kUnknownForUs) return false;
    *epoch_seconds = kBaseEpoch + static_cast<uint32_t>(us / 1000000);
    *millis_into_second = static_cast<uint16_t>((us % 1000000) / 1000);
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- statistics

enum { kBuckets = 11 };
static const char* const kBucketName[kBuckets] = {"0",     "1_4",     "5_9",      "10_14",
                                                  "15_19", "20_24",   "25",       "26_99",
                                                  "100_499", "500_plus", "idle"};
static int bucketOf(uint32_t d) {
    if (d == U8G2GL_IDLE) return 10;
    if (d == 0) return 0;
    if (d < 5) return 1;
    if (d < 10) return 2;
    if (d < 15) return 3;
    if (d < 20) return 4;
    if (d < 25) return 5;
    if (d == 25) return 6;
    if (d < 100) return 7;
    if (d < 500) return 8;
    return 9;
}

struct Phase {
    const char* name = "";
    bool blink = true;
    uint32_t duration_ms = 0;       // nominal
    int64_t start_us = 0, end_us = 0;
    uint32_t calls = 0, sent = 0, changed = 0, redundant = 0, idle_wakes = 0;
    uint64_t sum_send_us = 0, sum_nosend_us = 0;
    uint32_t min_send_us = 0xFFFFFFFFu, max_send_us = 0, max_nosend_us = 0;
    uint32_t hist[kBuckets] = {0};
    // loop
    uint32_t cap_hits = 0, idle_returns = 0, zero_deadlines = 0;
    // scroll
    uint32_t scroll_steps = 0, scroll_jumps = 0, scroll_back_other = 0, scroll_wraps = 0;
    int64_t first_step_us = 0, last_step_us = 0;
    uint32_t steps_since_first = 0;
    uint32_t max_step_gap_us = 0;
    uint32_t colon_toggles = 0;
    // seconds
    uint32_t second_changes = 0, skipped = 0, second_not_drawn = 0;
    int32_t lat_us[kMaxLat];
    uint32_t lat_n = 0;
    // redundant-send log: ms since phase start of the first kMaxRedundantLog
    uint32_t red_at_ms[kMaxRedundantLog];
};
static Phase s_boot, s_d1, s_d2, s_u;

static uint32_t s_last_second = 0;  // last epoch seen on the subject (0 = none yet)

// One ui_handler() call plus bookkeeping. Returns the deadline. Nothing printed.
static uint32_t timedCall(Phase& p, int64_t& t_start_us, int64_t& t_ret_us, bool& changed) {
    const int16_t scroll_before = s_ticker->scroll_x_;
    const bool colon_before = s_clock->is_colon_visible();
    t_start_us = esp_timer_get_time();
    const uint32_t d = ui_handler(display);
    t_ret_us = esp_timer_get_time();
    const uint32_t us = static_cast<uint32_t>(t_ret_us - t_start_us);

    const bool sent = us > kSendThresholdUs;
    const uint8_t* buf = display.getBufferPtr();
    changed = memcmp(buf, s_prev, kBufBytes) != 0;
    if (changed) memcpy(s_prev, buf, kBufBytes);

    p.calls++;
    if (sent) {
        p.sent++;
        p.sum_send_us += us;
        if (us < p.min_send_us) p.min_send_us = us;
        if (us > p.max_send_us) p.max_send_us = us;
        if (!changed) {
            if (p.redundant < kMaxRedundantLog)
                p.red_at_ms[p.redundant] = static_cast<uint32_t>((t_start_us - p.start_us) / 1000);
            p.redundant++;
        }
    } else {
        p.sum_nosend_us += us;
        if (us > p.max_nosend_us) p.max_nosend_us = us;
        if (!changed) p.idle_wakes++;
    }
    if (changed) p.changed++;
    p.hist[bucketOf(d)]++;
    if (d == 0) p.zero_deadlines++;

    // Scroll: the label advances one pixel per step and wraps to -width.
    const int16_t step = static_cast<int16_t>(s_ticker->scroll_x_ - scroll_before);
    if (step != 0) {
        uint32_t n = 0;
        if (step > 0) {
            n = static_cast<uint32_t>(step);
            if (step > 1) p.scroll_jumps++;
        } else if (s_ticker->scroll_x_ == static_cast<int16_t>(-s_ticker->get_w())) {
            n = 1;
            p.scroll_wraps++;
        } else {
            p.scroll_back_other++;
        }
        if (n) {
            p.scroll_steps += n;
            if (p.first_step_us == 0) {
                p.first_step_us = t_ret_us;
            } else {
                p.steps_since_first += n;
                const uint32_t gap = static_cast<uint32_t>(t_ret_us - p.last_step_us);
                if (gap > p.max_step_gap_us) p.max_step_gap_us = gap;
            }
            p.last_step_us = t_ret_us;
        }
    }
    if (s_clock->is_colon_visible() != colon_before) p.colon_toggles++;

    // Seconds: the wall clock (inside ui_handler) set the subject; latency = end of this call
    // minus that second's boundary on the esp_timer axis.
    const uint32_t sec = ui_subject_clock_time.get();
    if (sec != U8G2GL_TIME_UNKNOWN && sec != s_last_second) {
        if (s_last_second != 0) {
            p.second_changes++;
            if (sec - s_last_second > 1) p.skipped += sec - s_last_second - 1;
            if (!changed) p.second_not_drawn++;
            const int64_t boundary_us = static_cast<int64_t>(sec - kBaseEpoch) * 1000000;
            if (p.lat_n < kMaxLat) p.lat_us[p.lat_n++] = static_cast<int32_t>(t_ret_us - boundary_us);
        }
        s_last_second = sec;
    }
    return d;
}

// Loop pass shared by the capped phases: d = ui_handler(); delay(d), safety-net cap.
static void loopPass(Phase& p) {
    int64_t t0, t1;
    bool changed;
    const uint32_t d = timedCall(p, t0, t1, changed);
    if (d == U8G2GL_IDLE) p.idle_returns++;
    const uint32_t wait = (d == U8G2GL_IDLE || d > kDeadlineCapMs) ? kDeadlineCapMs : d;
    if (d != U8G2GL_IDLE && wait != d) p.cap_hits++;  // IDLE is reported separately
    delay(wait);
}

static void runCapped(Phase& p, const char* name, uint32_t ms, bool blink) {
    p.name = name;
    p.blink = blink;
    p.duration_ms = ms;
    s_clock->set_blink(blink);
    Serial.printf("U8G2GL-V phase=%s start duration_ms=%lu blink=%d loop=delay_to_deadline_cap_%lums\n",
                  name, (unsigned long)ms, blink ? 1 : 0, (unsigned long)kDeadlineCapMs);
    Serial.flush();
    p.start_us = esp_timer_get_time();
    const uint32_t start = millis();
    while (millis() - start < ms) loopPass(p);
    p.end_us = esp_timer_get_time();
}

static void runUncapped(Phase& p, const char* name, uint32_t ms) {
    p.name = name;
    p.duration_ms = ms;
    s_clock->set_blink(true);
    Serial.printf("U8G2GL-V phase=%s start duration_ms=%lu blink=1 loop=uncapped_no_delay\n", name,
                  (unsigned long)ms);
    Serial.flush();
    p.start_us = esp_timer_get_time();
    const uint32_t start = millis();
    int64_t t0, t1;
    bool changed;
    while (millis() - start < ms) timedCall(p, t0, t1, changed);
    p.end_us = esp_timer_get_time();
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- reporting

static void sortLat(int32_t* a, uint32_t n) {
    for (uint32_t i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        const int32_t v = a[i];
        uint32_t j = i;
        while (j > 0 && a[j - 1] > v) { a[j] = a[j - 1]; --j; }
        a[j] = v;
    }
}

static void printPhase(const Phase& p, bool capped) {
    const char* n = p.name;
    const double secs = (p.end_us - p.start_us) / 1e6;
    Serial.printf("U8G2GL-V phase=%s summary measured_s=%.2f calls=%lu calls_per_s=%.1f sent=%lu "
                  "changed=%lu redundant_sends=%lu idle_wakes=%lu\n",
                  n, secs, (unsigned long)p.calls, p.calls / secs, (unsigned long)p.sent,
                  (unsigned long)p.changed, (unsigned long)p.redundant, (unsigned long)p.idle_wakes);
    Serial.printf("U8G2GL-V phase=%s call_us n_send=%lu mean_send_us=%lu min_send_us=%lu "
                  "max_send_us=%lu n_nosend=%lu mean_nosend_us=%lu max_nosend_us=%lu "
                  "send_threshold_us=%lu separated=%d\n",
                  n, (unsigned long)p.sent, (unsigned long)(p.sent ? p.sum_send_us / p.sent : 0),
                  (unsigned long)(p.sent ? p.min_send_us : 0), (unsigned long)p.max_send_us,
                  (unsigned long)(p.calls - p.sent),
                  (unsigned long)((p.calls - p.sent) ? p.sum_nosend_us / (p.calls - p.sent) : 0),
                  (unsigned long)p.max_nosend_us, (unsigned long)kSendThresholdUs,
                  (p.sent == 0 || (p.max_nosend_us < kSendThresholdUs && p.min_send_us > kSendThresholdUs)) ? 1 : 0);
    Serial.printf("U8G2GL-V phase=%s deadline_hist_ms", n);
    for (int i = 0; i < kBuckets; ++i) Serial.printf(" %s=%lu", kBucketName[i], (unsigned long)p.hist[i]);
    Serial.printf(" zero_deadlines=%lu\n", (unsigned long)p.zero_deadlines);

    const double span = (p.last_step_us - p.first_step_us) / 1e6;
    Serial.printf("U8G2GL-V phase=%s scroll steps=%lu steps_per_s=%.2f (n=%lu steps over %.2f s; "
                  "px_per_s_target=40) max_step_gap_us=%lu wraps=%lu jumps_gt1px=%lu back_other=%lu "
                  "colon_toggles=%lu blink=%d\n",
                  n, (unsigned long)p.scroll_steps,
                  span > 0 ? p.steps_since_first / span : 0.0, (unsigned long)p.steps_since_first, span,
                  (unsigned long)p.max_step_gap_us, (unsigned long)p.scroll_wraps,
                  (unsigned long)p.scroll_jumps, (unsigned long)p.scroll_back_other,
                  (unsigned long)p.colon_toggles, p.blink ? 1 : 0);

    if (capped) {
        Serial.printf("U8G2GL-V phase=%s loop cap_ms=%lu cap_hits=%lu idle_returns=%lu\n", n,
                      (unsigned long)kDeadlineCapMs, (unsigned long)p.cap_hits,
                      (unsigned long)p.idle_returns);
        int32_t tmp[kMaxLat];
        memcpy(tmp, p.lat_us, sizeof(tmp));
        sortLat(tmp, p.lat_n);
        const uint32_t cnt = p.lat_n;
        if (cnt) {
            const uint32_t p95 = (cnt * 95 + 99) / 100 - 1;  // nearest rank
            Serial.printf("U8G2GL-V phase=%s second_latency_us n=%lu min=%ld median=%ld p95=%ld max=%ld "
                          "(boundary to end of the ui_handler() call that drew it) skipped_seconds=%lu "
                          "second_changes=%lu second_changes_without_buffer_change=%lu\n",
                          n, (unsigned long)cnt, (long)tmp[0], (long)tmp[cnt / 2], (long)tmp[p95],
                          (long)tmp[cnt - 1], (unsigned long)p.skipped, (unsigned long)p.second_changes,
                          (unsigned long)p.second_not_drawn);
        } else {
            Serial.printf("U8G2GL-V phase=%s second_latency_us n=0\n", n);
        }
    } else {
        const uint32_t k = p.redundant < kMaxRedundantLog ? p.redundant : kMaxRedundantLog;
        Serial.printf("U8G2GL-V phase=%s redundant_sends=%lu at_ms_since_phase_start=", n,
                      (unsigned long)p.redundant);
        if (k == 0) Serial.print("none");
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < k; ++i) Serial.printf("%s%lu", i ? "," : "", (unsigned long)p.red_at_ms[i]);
        Serial.printf(" (first %lu logged) skipped_seconds=%lu\n", (unsigned long)k, (unsigned long)p.skipped);
    }
}

static void printAll() {
    Serial.printf("U8G2GL-V method runtime=%s schema=0.4 generator=0.13.0 clock=esp_timer_get_time "
                  "unit=us buffer_bytes=%u time_unknown_for_ms=%ld base_epoch=%lu\n",
                  s_runtime_str, (unsigned)kBufBytes, (long)(kUnknownForUs / 1000), (unsigned long)kBaseEpoch);
    Serial.println("U8G2GL-V method defs sent=call_gt_threshold changed=buffer_differs "
                   "redundant=sent_and_not_changed idle_wake=not_sent_and_not_changed "
                   "second_latency=boundary_to_end_of_drawing_call scroll_rate=(steps-1)/span_of_"
                   "scroll_x_changes (reads label offset via private-as-public; logical offset, "
                   "not pixels)");
    Serial.printf("U8G2GL-V boot_pump calls=%lu redundant_sends=%lu (before the phases, from boot "
                  "to ~%lu ms)\n",
                  (unsigned long)s_boot.calls, (unsigned long)s_boot.redundant,
                  (unsigned long)kBootPumpUntilMs);
    printPhase(s_d1, true);
    printPhase(s_d2, true);
    printPhase(s_u, false);
    Serial.println("U8G2GL-V end");
}

static uint32_t s_last_report_ms = 0;

void setup() {
    SPI.begin(kPinSck, kPinMiso, kPinMosi, -1);
    display.begin();

    // Bring the UI up first so the panel shows --:--:-- from (nearly) boot; the serial wait
    // below must not delay the 5 s unknown window.
    u8g2gl_set_tick_cb(tickNow);
    ui_init();
    s_ticker = static_cast<u8g2gl_label*>(ui_screen_measure.objs[0]);
    s_clock = static_cast<u8g2gl_clock*>(ui_screen_measure.objs[1]);
    u8g2gl_wall_clock_init(&s_wall_clock, &ui_subject_clock_time, timeFn);
    u8g2gl_set_active_screen(&ui_screen_measure);

    s_boot.name = "boot";
    s_boot.start_us = esp_timer_get_time();
    Serial.begin(115200);

    // Pump the UI while waiting (up to 3 s) for the host's serial port.
    {
        int64_t t0, t1;
        bool changed;
        ui_handler(display);
        memcpy(s_prev, display.getBufferPtr(), kBufBytes);
        while (!Serial && millis() < 3000) {
            const uint32_t d = timedCall(s_boot, t0, t1, changed);
            delay(d == U8G2GL_IDLE || d > 50 ? 50 : d);
        }
    }
    static char ver[16];
    snprintf(ver, sizeof(ver), "%d.%d.%d", U8G2GL_VERSION_MAJOR, U8G2GL_VERSION_MINOR, U8G2GL_VERSION_PATCH);
    s_runtime_str = ver;
    Serial.printf("U8G2GL-V boot env=v runtime=%s note=\"panel should show --:--:-- for 5 s after "
                  "boot, then seconds ticking\" boot_ms=%lu\n",
                  ver, (unsigned long)millis());
    Serial.flush();

    // Boot pump: the same loop, so the first known second has landed before D1 starts.
    {
        int64_t t0, t1;
        bool changed;
        while (millis() < kBootPumpUntilMs) {
            const uint32_t d = timedCall(s_boot, t0, t1, changed);
            delay(d == U8G2GL_IDLE || d > kDeadlineCapMs ? kDeadlineCapMs : d);
        }
    }
    s_last_second = 0;  // the first known second after this is the baseline, not a latency sample

    runCapped(s_d1, "D1", kPhaseD1Ms, true);
    runCapped(s_d2, "D2", kPhaseD2Ms, false);
    runUncapped(s_u, "U", kPhaseUMs);
    s_clock->set_blink(true);
    printAll();
    s_last_report_ms = millis();
}

void loop() {
    if (millis() - s_last_report_ms >= 5000) {
        s_last_report_ms = millis();
        printAll();
    }
    delay(20);
}
